create_miniwob_env: create a MiniWobEnv instance with a base URL and cursor directory for browser automation
start_episode_miniwob: start a new MiniWob episode with a task name and random seed
get_dom_miniwob: get the DOM info from the current MiniWob environment state
execute_action_miniwob: execute an action string in the MiniWob environment using the processed action handler
normalize_reward_miniwob: normalize a raw MiniWob reward from [-1,1] to [0,1]
